text:
AFK Vindicta and Gorvek

​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Positioning

⬥ Position yourself 2 tiles west of where Vindicta spawns.
​
Magic AFK Method
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Penance powder 
Other
⬥ Auto-cast Incite Fear
⬥ Animate Dead 
⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast 
⬥ Greater Sonic Wave 
⬥ Ripper Demon 








​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Magic Preset 

​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills

​
Melee AFK Method (~60 kph)
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Abilities
⬥ Chaos Roar 
⬥ Greater Fury 
Other
⬥ Pray Deflect Magic  + Turmoil 
⬥ Do not activate your book
⬥ Do not use a DPS familiar like 
    • You can use a Legendary Pet pick up drops
⬥ Strength cape perk 
Optional
⬥ Use of Enhanced excalibur  and/or Overload   can reduce death risk








​

​

​

⬥ Melee examples
​
Necromancy AFK Method (50+ kph)
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Amulet of Souls  or 
⬥ 2 pieces of Cryptbloom armour   +  or 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mor  or Igneous Kal-Zuk 
⬥ Armour with Enhanced Devoted 4 
⬥ Scripture of Jas  or Scripture of Wen 
Other
⬥ Animate Dead 
⬥ Vampyrism aura  highly recommended for long AFK
⬥ Pray Deflect Magic  + Sorrow 
    • Ruination  requires additional prayer restoration
⬥ Bonfire lifepoints boost  and Ogre flask (Thermal)  recommended.








​
Presets and Relics 
⬥ Necromancy preset 

​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills
⬥ Necromancy
​
Ranged AFK Method (58+ kph) 
Overview

















Mandatory AFK Requirements

The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

⬥ Penance powder 
⬥ Optional follower:
    • Legendary Pet to auto-collect drops
    • Holy scarab  to remove need for  / 
⬥ Greater Death's Swiftness 
⬥ Greater Ricochet
